mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over a 3-month period signals an emerging economic slowdown, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or above 4.0%, it signals persistent inflation and a hawkish monetary policy stance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS >= 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1450.0 thousand units signals an impending slowdown in the housing market, which reduces consumer confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST declines > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% annualized over the past quarter signals strong economic demand, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2% annualized.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 (index, 2017=100) over a 3-month period signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%) with slowing job growth (PAYEMS growth < 50k in the last month), it signals an impending labor market slowdown and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth < 50k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth < 50k in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) below 700,000 million dollars signals reduced household borrowing, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines > 1.0% in 1 month.
